name: Horn Tidal
description: Horn Tidal is tidally locked to its star, creating a permanent division between a sunlit ocean hemisphere and a dark frozen one. At the terminator line, where light meets shadow, horn-shaped ice formations rise from the water where warm and freezing currents collide, some reaching fifty meters in height. The sunlit side supports a thriving marine flora ecosystem, while the dark side holds frozen methane lakes atop a shell of sea ice.

The terminator zone is the most dramatic environment on the planet, where warm mist from the sunlit ocean meets frigid air from the dark side, creating perpetual fog banks laced with ice crystals. The light here is diffuse and golden, scattered by the moisture, and every surface gleams with frost. The quiet is profound, broken only by the groaning of ice and the soft lap of waves against frozen shores.

Smugglers discovered Horn Tidal decades ago and have used the ice formations along the terminator as natural hiding spots for contraband. The horn-shaped ice structures are large enough to conceal small ships, and the electromagnetic interference from the competing thermal zones makes scanning difficult. The legitimate discovery of valuable flora compounds on the sunlit side has brought unwanted attention to a world the underworld preferred forgotten.

The rare flora that thrive in Horn Tidal's sunlit waters produce compounds with potent regenerative properties, making them extraordinarily valuable to the medical industry. Smuggler operations have grown increasingly aggressive in defending their territory from corporate survey teams. The ice horns at the terminator are slowly growing, suggesting the locked hemispheres are shifting, which could reshape the entire planetary ecosystem within a generation.
